meta.title: Firefly III bookkeeping
meta.description: Record, query, correct and delete Firefly III transactions from chat, and maintain the accounts, categories, budgets and tags they depend on. Nine domain tools cover transactions, master data, reports, subscriptions/recurrences/piggy banks, attachments, rules/currencies/webhooks and CSV exports. Reads live metadata before every write, refuses to guess ids when autoCreate is off, and requires approval for deletions, bulk moves, budget-limit changes, rule/webhook triggers and currency changes. Purge and destroy endpoints are permanently blocked. Save the personal access token with /firefly-token (it is not logged); /firefly-status verifies the connection. Attachments stay inside the session workspace and obey maxAttachmentMb. Transaction data is sent only to the configured Firefly III instance. When the session approval policy is Never, destructive actions are refused; switch it to Ask to use them. The Settings → Firefly III page flips the five autoCreate switches, shows the connection facts, and tests the connection; saving goes through the config editor into the local profile.
